title: Share of the Releasable Retainage Released Against Inspections Passed
content:
# Share of the Releasable Retainage Released Against Inspections Passed

How much of the releasable retainage on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects goes out at closeout is measured by the inspections the installed work has passed.

## Rule

Where an authority inspection and a commissioning inspection have both been passed on the project, the share released is the whole of the releasable retainage, that is **100 per cent**.

Where an authority inspection has been passed and no commissioning inspection stands on the project, the share released is **90 per cent** of the releasable retainage, the balance staying until the system is commissioned.

Where no authority inspection has been passed on the project, the share released is **50 per cent** of the releasable retainage.

## What counts as which inspection

An authority inspection is a mechanical permit inspection or a fire marshal inspection passed on the project; a commissioning inspection is an inspection passed on the project under the commissioning class. Only inspections recorded as passed on the project count.

| Authority inspection passed | Commissioning inspection passed | Share released |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 100 per cent |
| yes | no | 90 per cent |
| no | yes | 50 per cent |
| no | no | 50 per cent |

Where no authority inspection has been passed, the commissioning inspection makes no difference: the share is 50 per cent either way.

## Worked shares (hypothetical releasable retainage of USD 30000)

Both inspections passed: USD 30000.00 released. A mechanical permit inspection passed and no commissioning: USD 27000.00. Neither: USD 15000.00.
